newsitem.title: USA: Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc Q3 shr rises.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc Q3 shr rises.

text.p: First Call mean estimate for Q3 $0.80
(Unaudited - amounts in millions except per share data)
Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended
NOTE: Q3 96 EPS reduced by $0.17 due to estimated impact of a voluntary recall of Albuminar and Plasma Plex by Centeon L.L.C., a joint venture of which Rhone-Poulenc Rorer owns 50 percent.
Pro forma results prepared as if the acquisitions of

Fisons Plc and Applied Immune Sciences Inc and formation of Centeon joint venture occurred on Jan. 1, 1995 and include adjustments for financing charges and amortization related to the acquisition transactions.
EPS for nine-month pro forma 95 include the effect of
pro forma charges totaling $1.6 million related to the acquisitions of Cooperation Pharmaceutique Francaise and Rhodia Farma from Rhone-Poulenc S.A.
Company is 68 percent owned by Rhone-Poulenc SA
